ideas.pitch: A Python-based CLI tool that automatically generates malicious edge-case test cases to break algorithmic solutions during the final hacking phase.
ideas.title: Adversarial Test Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the final showdown round where participants must test and break other participants' solutions using carefully designed test cases.

ideas.pitch: A real-time performance and code diff analyzer built for head-to-head 1v1 coding battles to track algorithmic efficiency and speed.
ideas.title: 1v1 Match Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the exact format of Round 1 where competitors race to outscore opponents under strict time constraints.

ideas.pitch: A strategic simulation dashboard that parses algorithm outputs and visualizes moves made during the competitive programming and gameplay rounds.
ideas.title: Strategy Visualizer for Game Battles
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines algorithmic problem-solving with strategic gameplay visualization, appealing directly to the core theme of the IEEE CS Chapter event.

ideas.pitch: An introductory problem-solving platform and automated grading runner designed to onboard participants to the competition format.
ideas.title: Warm-Up Benchmark Suite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the organizers and judges face directly during Round 0 — getting participants familiar with the competition format.

ideas.pitch: An automated auditing tool that verifies the correctness of test cases submitted during the final hacking phase to prevent invalid exploits.
ideas.title: Final Showdown Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific pain point of the final showdown where participants try to break solutions using carefully designed test cases.
